items.title: February 2027 Heart Ribbon Lettering
items.alt: Burgundy February lettering sits beneath a pink satin heart ribbon, above ivory 2027 numerals and two red heart seals.
items.description: Looped satin ribbon frames the ornate month name, with wax-like heart seals flanking the pale raised year.

items.title: March 2027 Kite Lettering
items.alt: A green diamond kite flies above green March lettering and blue 2027 numerals, with clover leaves at the sides.
items.description: The kite’s golden string curves across the bold lettering, balancing its trailing green ribbons and the two small clovers.

items.title: April 2027 Umbrella Lettering
items.alt: A lilac umbrella shelters purple April lettering above aqua 2027 numerals surrounded by blue raindrops.
items.description: The curved umbrella handle extends below the glossy year, bringing the whole rainy-day heading into one compact shape.

items.title: May 2027 Tulip Planter
items.alt: Coral May lettering stands before pink tulips in a cream planter marked 2027, with a watering can pouring from above.
items.description: Green leaves fill the flowerpot around the raised month name, while floral decorations frame the year on its front.

items.title: June 2027 Sunshine and Seashells
items.alt: Turquoise June lettering rises above sandy 2027 numerals, with a golden sun and two seashells.
items.description: Small aqua splashes and a sunburst give the smooth month lettering a bright contrast against the grainy sand-textured year.

items.title: July 2027 Pennant Lettering
items.alt: Navy July lettering and red 2027 numerals sit beneath red, white and navy pennants, with gold starbursts at the sides.
items.description: Fine gold borders sharpen the large serif letters and numerals, while striped ribbon ties finish the garland.
